stemMarkdown: Find the difference between the compound interest and the simple interest on ₹1000 for 2 years at 20% per annum (interest compounded annually).
solutionMarkdown: SI for 2 years $= \dfrac{P \times r \times t}{100} = \dfrac{1000 \times 20 \times 2}{100} = 400.00$. CI for 2 years $= P\left[(1+r/100)^2 - 1\right] = 1000\left[(1+20/100)^2 - 1\right] = 440.00$. Difference $= 440.00 - 400.00 = 40.00$.
